entities.name: Ghalma
entities.description: A loxodon artificer of Mirrodin who shapes metal like liquid to craft toys, trinkets and small artifact creatures.

entities.name: Razor Circle Passages
entities.description: Passages Ghalma created for survivors in the Razor Fields to reach other refugees in the Furnace Layer.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The transformed Mirrodin that Ghalma survived.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A layer of New Phyrexia where refugees are found.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: A region where survivors used Ghalma's passages.

events.summary: Ghalma survives the advent of New Phyrexia and creates Razor Circle Passages for survivors in the Razor Fields.
events.quote: Ghalma survived the advent of New Phyrexia

relations.note: Ghalma was responsible for creating them.
relations.quote: was responsible for creating Razor Circle Passages
